name: Nuvio + AetherEngine
subtitle: Nuvio with the AetherEngine player: Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, lossless audio.
description:
Unofficial build of Nuvio that follows every upstream release and adds AetherEngine as a third player on iOS, next to the internal MPV player and external apps.

AetherEngine plays through Apple's native pipeline: Dolby Vision (profiles 5, 7, 8 and AV1), HDR10+, Dolby Atmos passthrough, and lossless multichannel audio for TrueHD and DTS-HD MA.

Pick it in Settings > Playback > Player.
